lead.headline: A bye at D/ST, and one claim to fix it
lead.deck: Week 10 won by 25; Week 11 opens with the Packers on bye and no second defence. Claim the Steelers before 02:00 Wednesday.
lead.body: Bad news first: Green Bay are on bye, so your D/ST scores nothing unless a claim lands, and the free-agent plan from Monday is gone — every unrostered player went to waivers at the rollover. Garrett Wilson's quarterback, Geno Smith, had ankle imaging that showed no major injury, but he has not practised; Waddle has not practised since his concussion. Week 10 was a 136.94-111.56 win over Nicky Jam with 11.2 left on the bench (archive). The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Panda Attack's 103.9 includes two bye-week zeros they can still fill.

players.caption: His quarterback's ankle is the question.

doFirst.headline: One claim before 02:00 Wednesday
doFirst.deck: Steelers, then Chiefs, then Bears — each dropping the Packers D/ST.
doFirst.note: Only one claim can land; the chain covers a rival taking the Steelers first.
